caption: The drawing depicts a large, tan-colored stoneware jug with a cylindrical body and a narrow neck that flares slightly at the top. The jug has a rough, speckled surface texture. On the front of the jug, there is a blue decorative illustration showing a spotted animal, possibly a dog, standing on a patch of ground with tufts of grass and a small wooden fence to the left, as well as a leafy plant or tree behind the animal. Near the top of the jug, there is blue text and a numeral "2" beneath what appears to be the words "F.B. NORTON" and "WORCESTER." In the top right corner of the drawing, there is a smaller depiction of the same jug showing a side view with a handle attached to the neck. The background of the drawing is a plain beige color, and the jug casts a faint shadow on the surface beneath it.
title: Jug
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
